construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch in the isolated working directory

shared_schema.input: synthetic flag; profile experience/detail/topics/completed; fixed safety_rules; grid_assets; topology; meter_csv; SCADA-synthetic telemetry; outage_reports; topic-tagged passages
shared_schema.output: versioned synthetic envelope with status, notice, onboarding, research, and sanitized entities
shared_schema.validation: One validate(kind, value, context) boundary checks input, onboarding and research. The same input is revalidated before research; citations and handoffs are checked against their source.

cross_stage_handoffs: Validated input becomes experience-aware prerequisites and detail-aware explanations.
Validated onboarding topics, detail preference and readiness control passage retrieval.
Missing prerequisites block research without auto-completing training; explicitly update completed and rerun.
Research validates its findings and exact citation offsets against supplied source passages.

behavior.retrieval: Deterministic curated topic-tag matching, sorted by source_id; brief returns one passage per topic, guided returns all. Findings are entire verbatim passages, cited with source ID, title and Unicode character start/end offsets.
behavior.asset_protection: All internal synthetic identifiers are replaced with public aliases in entity output. Sources containing internal identifiers are rejected, preserving exact citation text. A final leak check covers serialized output.
behavior.outage_policy: Life safety P1 overrides essential service; otherwise essential service P2, routine P3. Declared rules and report priority must agree.
behavior.emissions: Nonnegative finite figures require kgCO2e or tCO2e units and an existing source ID.
behavior.errors: CLI validation, JSON, CSV and file errors produce one generic status:error JSON object and exit 2; successful and prerequisite-blocked valid runs exit 0.
behavior.fixture: Clearly synthetic two-node topology, fictitious substation/meter IDs, winter and summer interval readings, SCADA-style telemetry, and safety-prioritized outage.

coverage: CLI success, determinism, file, usage and malformed-input errors
